english:
You know the deal.
Five quiz answers right
in a row, or no win. Work here forever,
or try again.
Got it?
Huh? The NAS plan?\nWhat the hell?
Want a fight?\nI'll take you on anytime!
Hah! You're no match\nfor our evil organization!
The Gin Tama I used?\nThe one that looks tough\nbut's totally useless?
Only three parts?\nPretty simple design\nfor a legendary weapon.

Left Ball...
Right Ball...
Center Pole... Looks like we need
all three to finish it.
And all three parts\nseem to be here in Edo.
Still at it?\nGive it a rest.
Tch. Quit it,\nor you'll get hurt!
Enough, Kondo.\nI know what you're thinking.
Toshi, find the parts!\nEdo could be in danger...
But where do we\neven start looking?
Kondo has a point,\nbut dealing with this\ncase comes first.
Sogo, leave it.\nKondo has his own\nway of doing things.
Kondo, you've got\nthings out of order.
That's shady as hell!\nWhat IS this monument?!
These aren't everywhere!\nNot this stupid thing!
...The parts have\ngotta be hidden\nin this thing.
Who said there was\nnothing suspicious?\nHuh, Sogo?
A NAS Cannon monument?\nDamn, that's well made.
SECURITY PROGRAM ON.\nGIN TAMA BATTLE ACTIVATED.
Oh, just your everyday\nNAS Cannon monument.
It's about the only\nNAS Cannon clue we have.
Some kind of defense\nprogram, I guess.\nGood luck, Hijikata.
A NAS Cannon monument...\nDamn, that's well made.
Hmph! Giving me trouble,\nand you're not even alive...
For now, let's give\nthis to old man\nMatsudaira.
I can't believe it...\nBeaten by an\ninanimate object!
A loss is a loss.\n...But Hijikata,\ndo better next time.
Sogo!\nWant me to use it on you?!
Hold it! Why use it\non your own men?\nThis kind of ball...
Save it for someone\nyou absolutely\nhave to beat.

Yeah, somehow
we got this. I'm serious! It's not like we
put the parts together
and got a Gin Tama!
Anyway, good luck.\nBring more parts,\nI'll get you another.
Hijikata, let's test\njust how strong it is.\n...On you.
Then I'll use\n[Batting Machine]\nto hit it back.
Didn't we do this\nsort of thing before?
All right, Kondo.\nLeave it to me.
Seems our image\nhas taken a hit lately.
We'll get people\ntrying to sabotage it.
Hey! Got a problem\nwith me doing it?
The hell was that?!\nBring it on, bastard!!
Oh, wanna go?!\nGin Tama battle, idiot!
What are you saying?!\nWe don't care\nabout that!
Not like I WANT\nto parade.\nDon't make trouble.

Hey, you!
Quit flirting
with the idol! Let us have
a date with her too!
Shut the hell up!\fWe'll wreck\nyour stupid parade!
Okay... Have mercy!\fWe won't make\nany more trouble.
We win!\nServes you right!\fWe'll wreck\nthat parade!
Did you lose\na Gin Tama battle?\fSo much for\nour image.
Me too! Let's rub it\nin China Girl's\nface later!
What are you doing?\nYou're off\nthe parade route!
A cop getting lost?\nNot funny.\fSo much for\nour image.
Yes, sir!\nYou get back\nto the parade too.
All right!\nTime for a parade\nto promote the Joi!
Of course.\nKeep Kabukicho\nsafe for us, okay?
By a match, you\nmean Gin Tama?
Nope, he's a lost cause.\nCan't stop him now...
Shut up!\nI'm at my best\nwhen I'm drunk!
Fine, you bastard!\nIf it's a Gin Tama\nbattle, you're on!!
Sure, leave it to me!\nTen bottles of\nDom Perignon on reserve!
